$description: PrintDocument (platform/patterns/PrintDocument, issue 87, #348): its component tokens. The frame, padding and size are the sheet's print roles, which change on paper.

print-document-border-width.$description: PrintDocument: the sheet's border width; 0 on paper.

print-document-radius.$description: PrintDocument: the sheet's corners; square on paper.

print-document-shadow.$description: PrintDocument: the sheet's shadow (shadow-card); none on paper.

print-document-padding.$description: PrintDocument: the sheet's padding (the document margin); 0 on paper, where the page carries it.
